mechanism: STOMP self-join builds Matrix Profile P[i]=min z-normalized Euclidean distance from each length-m window to any non-overlapping neighbor. Distance D=sqrt(2m(1-rho)) from sliding FFT/MASS dots plus rolling mean/std; exclusion zone ceil(m/4). Low P → motif (repeated shape); high P → discord (anomaly). Series mean-centered before compute so QT−m·μi·μj cancellation stays numerically stable on gold-scale prices.
data_needed: Price array length n (e.g. closes); window m; prefix sums for rolling μ/σ; FFT MASS first row then STOMP recurrence; profile P and index I.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 demo (m=48 over ~500 bars); gold-scale (~2000) numerical stress; any OHLC series.
why_new_for_mis: Parameter-light sequence sensor that jointly ranks repeated regimes (motifs) and unprecedented windows (discords) without labeled patterns—fills a gap vs oscillators that neither match shapes nor flag anomalies.
quote: A low value means the window has a close twin, so it is part of a repeated pattern, called a motif. A high value means the window has no twin, so it is an anomaly, called a discord.

mechanism: On each new bar recompute profile over recent history; live anomaly score = P of latest completed window. Threshold = adaptive percentile of current profile (sorted copy). If live > percentile → treat as discord and optionally fade or follow the move that produced it; else stand aside. Top-k discords also neighborhood-masked (±m/2) so ranked events are distinct.
data_needed: Live Matrix Profile; latest P[L-1]; ProfilePercentile(pct); optional fade/follow direction from recent move.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 Strategy Tester H1 2026H1 demo; InpAnomalyPct gate.
why_new_for_mis: Turns raw discord distance into a self-calibrating change/anomaly regime gate that adapts to how varied recent market structure has been, rather than a fixed distance cutoff.
quote: What counts as anomalous is not a hardcoded distance: it is a percentile of the current profile, recomputed every bar, so the threshold adapts to how varied the recent market has been.

mechanism: At SL modification time sample ask−bid (not at registration). Breakeven: long SL=open+spread+buffer·pip_size; short SL=open−spread−buffer·pip_size. Pip size = 10×point on 3/5-digit symbols else point. Activation measured vs close side (bid for long, ask for short) in real pips.
data_needed: SYMBOL_ASK/BID at modify instant; open price; digits/point; activation_pips; buffer_pips.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any MT5 symbol incl. 3/5-digit FX; demo compares managed vs naive open-price SL under spread spikes.
why_new_for_mis: Explicit live-spread liquidity sensor baked into protective price levels—MIS can reuse the same ask−bid sample as a thin-liquidity / news-spike hazard when sizing stops.
quote: the spread has to be read at the exact moment the stop loss is about to be modified, not stored once at registration and reused

mechanism: Every tick: realized P&L from server-midnight HistorySelect exit deals (profit+swap+commission on DEAL_ENTRY_OUT/INOUT) plus floating POSITION_PROFIT+POSITION_SWAP. Remaining buffer = combined_pnl − daily_loss_limit (both negative for losses); ≤limit → HALTED until next server midnight.
data_needed: Deal history since server midnight; open positions profit+swap; configured daily_loss_limit (e.g. −500).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Account-wide any symbols; tick evaluation; server-time day boundary.
why_new_for_mis: Account-level daily risk-state sensor (buffer OK vs HALTED) complementary to market regimes—useful for MIS to gate signals when prop-style loss capacity is exhausted.
quote: computes the account's combined daily P&L (realized + floating, including swap) using the broker's server midnight as the reset boundary

mechanism: Initial Entry/SL/TP distances from ATR(period,TF)×factors (default SL=1×ATR, TP=2×ATR); fallback 100 points if ATR unavailable. Market entry tracks Ask (buy) or Bid (sell); pending entries offset from market by ATR distances. Lot from risk%×balance / (stopDistance/tickSize×tickValue), normalized to volume min/max/step.
data_needed: iATR(InpATRTimeframe, InpATRPeriod); Bid/Ask; SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE/SIZE; volume min/max/step; InpRiskPercent.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart _Symbol; ATR TF default H1 period 14; six order types Buy/Sell × Market/Limit/Stop.
why_new_for_mis: Volatility-native spacing sensor for planned risk geometry—ATR-scaled stop/target distances as a live vol regime input to position geometry, not a fixed-point rule.
quote: Instead of starting with arbitrary fixed distances, the tool uses current market volatility to establish practical initial spacing between the three levels.

mechanism: OLAP MetaCube: map each trade Record through Selectors (Symbol, WeekDay of open/close, Type, Magic, DayHour, duration bins, Quants) into cells; aggregators Sum/Average/Max/Min/Count/ProfitFactor/ProgressiveTotal/Identity over fields like profit, MFE/MAE. Example: profit×symbol×weekday-of-close yields calendar×instrument performance surface.
data_needed: Account history / HTML / CSV trade records; TRADE_RECORD_FIELDS incl. custom MFE/MAE; selector set and aggregator choice.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Multi-symbol accounts (e.g. FDAX, XAUUSD, UKBrent, NQ, EURUSD); CSV signal histories (GBPUSD…); deal-level not bar TF.
why_new_for_mis: Turns historical fills into a multidimensional calendar/instrument profitability sensor (weekday×hour×symbol regimes of edge), reusable as a prior for MIS session filters.
quote: a breakdown of profit by symbols, days of the week, buy and sell operations might be useful

mechanism: CustomTradeRecord fills FIELD_CUSTOM1/2 with MFE and MAE per position; IdentityAggregator + SerialNumberSelector plots per-deal MFE% vs MAE% (and duration vs profit) without aggregation—exposes path-quality of trades as a scatter sensing surface in GUI.
data_needed: Per-trade MFE/MAE from bar path between open and close; IdentityAggregator; GUI CPlot.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Account/report trades any symbols; duration optionally scaled by PeriodSeconds() bars.
why_new_for_mis: Excursion pair (favorable vs adverse) as a trade-path quality sensor—MIS can mirror MFE/MAE on live open risk or on labeled historical regimes.
quote: MFE (%) and MAE (%) dependencies for all deals

mechanism: OptCacheDataAdapter reads *.opt passes (ExpTradeSummary + EA inputs). QuantizationSelector bins standard stats (profit, PF, DD, Sharpe…) and EA parameters; AverageAggregator and VarianceAggregator compare mean profit vs dispersion across a parameter axis—flags parameter regions where variance exceeds mean (fragile edge).
data_needed: TesterCache *.opt file; OPT_CACHE_RECORD_FIELDS; QuantGranularity; average and variance aggregators.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Integrity.opt example (PricePeriod, Momentum, Sigma); optimization-pass grain.
why_new_for_mis: Robustness sensor over strategy parameter space—pairs expected payoff with dispersion so MIS can distrust high-mean/high-variance pockets.
quote: By comparing these two histograms, we can estimate with which parameter values the dispersion does not exceed the average value

series_key: automating classic market methods in mql5
mechanism: Finite state machine IDLE→RANGE_FORMING→SPRING/UPTHRUST→SOS/SOW→IN_TRADE. DetectRange finds sideways high/low after prior up/downtrend (split-half HH/LL), height in pip band, bars within 25% tolerance; bias=accumulation if price fell into range else distribution. Avg tick volume inside range is baseline.
data_needed: H/L/tick volume Copy*; InpTrendBars/MinMaxRangeBars/Pips; prior-trend helpers; SWyckoffRange.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H4 recommended; also stated instrument-agnostic (EURUSD, gold); backtest 2022–2024.
why_new_for_mis: Sequential cause-and-effect regime sensor: range-after-trend plus directional bias—stronger than isolated support breaks because context is enforced by states.
quote: each Wyckoff event only carries meaning in the context of the events that preceded it

series_key: automating classic market methods in mql5
mechanism: Spring: low penetrates support−tolerance, closes back above support, tickVol < avgRangeVol×InpLowVolMult (absorption). SOS: close > resistance AND tickVol > avgRangeVol×InpHighVolMult (demand). Mirror for upthrust (low-vol false breakout) and SOW (high-vol breakdown). Always relative ratios, not absolute ticks.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H4; relative volume claimed valid on major FX (corr>0.85 vs real) and gold.
why_new_for_mis: Paired low-vol shakeout vs high-vol confirmation as a liquidity/participation signature for regime transitions—MIS can reuse the same relative-volume template outside Wyckoff labels.
quote: Every volume check in the EA computes a rolling average over the bars within the current range and compares each bar as a ratio against that baseline.

series_key: automating classic market methods in mql5
mechanism: Daily SMA(150)≈30-week: slope=(MA_now−MA_past)/lookback/price vs InpSlopeThreshold. Stage2: MA rising + price>MA + higher highs; Stage4: MA falling + price<MA + lower lows; Stage1: MA flat + price≥MA; Stage3: MA flat + price≤MA (plus transitional rising-MA/price-below → Stage3, falling-MA/price-above → Stage1). Trade Stage2/4 transitions only.
data_needed: iMA(150,SMA,close); slope lookback; HH/LL lookback; prior stage for transition detect.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Forex on daily (150≈30-week); H4 750-period mentioned as alternate; RSI(14)≥50 long / ≤50 short filter.
why_new_for_mis: Lifecycle regime sensor (Base/Advance/Top/Decline) from normalized MA slope + structure—cleaner four-state market phase than binary trend flags.
quote: When the 30-week MA is rising and the price is above it, the market is in Stage 2. The reverse, when the 30-week MA is falling and price is below it, the market is in Stage 4.

series_key: automating classic market methods in mql5
mechanism: Stage2/4 entry requires breakout bar tickVol > avg(InpVolAvgPeriod)×InpVolBreakoutMult (~1.8) plus RSI momentum. Exit Stage2 long only if close < MA AND volume > avg×InpExitVolMult (~1.5)—low-vol MA touch ignored as pullback.
data_needed: Tick volume window; MA; RSI; exit vol multiplier.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Daily FX; relative tick volume adaptation of Weinstein 2–3× equity volume rule.
why_new_for_mis: Participation-gated regime-change: stage transition is not enough—volume must confirm breakout and MA breach, separating noise touches from genuine phase shifts.
quote: A close below the MA on low volume during Stage 2 is a normal pullback—Weinstein explicitly warned against exiting on every minor MA touch.

series_key: automating classic market methods in mql5
mechanism: All eight must pass: price>MA150 & MA200; MA150>MA200; MA200 rising vs 20 bars ago; MA50>MA150 & MA200; price>MA50; price ≥25% above 52-week low (250 bars); price within 25% of 52-week high; RSI(14)≥50 as RS substitute. Then 20-bar high breakout with vol≥1.5×20-bar avg. Exit if close < MA50.
data_needed: SMA 50/150/200; 250-bar year high/low; RSI; tick volume; 20-bar breakout ref from bars 2..
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Forex daily; InpTradeShorts optional mirror; stocks originally.
why_new_for_mis: Conjunctive structural trend-quality sensor—MA stack + distance-from-year-extremes + momentum—filters for leadership-like advances usable as a strict bullish regime mask.
quote: The power comes from requiring all eight conditions simultaneously.

series_key: automating classic market methods in mql5
mechanism: N = Wilder-smoothed 20-day True Range: seed=SMA of first 20 TRs then N=(N_prev×19+TR)/20. Unit lots so 2N stop risks InpRiskPerUnit% equity: lots = (equity×risk%)/(N_dollars×2). Pyramid adds at +0.5N, max 4 units, unified stop advances to 2N from newest entry.
data_needed: H/L/C for TR; InpATRPeriod=20; tick_value/tick_size; equity.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD multi-year daily recommended; any liquid market per Turtle design.
why_new_for_mis: Canonical volatility unit (Wilder N) as a portable risk/vol sensor—MIS can express thresholds and stops in N rather than fixed pips across instruments.
quote: N is the foundation of the entire risk management system. Every position size, every stop, and every pyramid interval is expressed in units of N.

series_key: automating classic market methods in mql5
mechanism: System1: bar1 high>highest(bars 2..21) or low<lowest → 20-day breakout; skip if last S1 trade in that direction was a winner (last_s1_winner). System2: 55-day breakout, no skip. Exits: S1 via 10-day opposite extreme; S2 via 20-day; plus hard 2N stop.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD daily; BOTH systems simultaneous as original Turtles.
why_new_for_mis: Dual-horizon Donchian change sensor plus winner-skip anti-chase rule—MIS can use short vs long breakout agreement and skip-state as trend-exhaustion context.
quote: The skip rule: if the previous System 1 breakout in the same direction was a profitable trade… the current breakout is skipped.
